summary: Steep west kerb with houses 8-9 m from the whole stretch.
reasons: Few cars parked, would stand out

best_section.where: Woodstock Avenue west kerb, in front of the low-set houses

drivers.seclusion: Houses and front gardens 8-9 m away on the kerb's own side from start to 33 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; one car parked on the kerb, a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; little kerbside parking.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of the section
Mapped gate 78 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Open kerb with a few street trees; sun from the west falls on the kerb in the afternoon.
